subject.title: experimental.sessionMemory does not surface gateway-dispatched sessions in memory_search

question: Should OpenClaw accept owner-scoped live orphan session transcript hits in memory_search when the existing visibility guard permits them, while handling broader private cross-conversation recall through a separate default-off product setting?
rationale: The remaining bug sits on a transcript privacy boundary, and there are two active implementation paths: a narrow mergeable bug-fix PR and a broader maintainer-owned feature PR with compatibility/security risk.

options.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
options.body: Accept the targeted owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep the existing fail-closed cross-agent/sandbox behavior, and handle automatic private recall separately.

options.title: Fold into broader recall feature
options.body: Pause the narrow PR and resolve this only through the default-off remember-across-conversations product surface once that branch is clean.

options.title: Keep current fail-closed behavior
options.body: Require a session-store entry for live transcript hits and close the remaining recall gap as an intentional privacy tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Land narrow visibility fix first
recommendation.body: Accept the targeted owner-scoped live-orphan repair, keep the existing fail-closed cross-agent/sandbox behavior, and handle automatic private recall separately.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the overlapping maintainer product direction and can decide how the narrow bug fix should coexist with the broader private recall feature.
